title: Difference Array Range Updates
statement:
You have an array of N zeros. Apply Q range-add operations. Each operation adds a value V to every element from index L to R (1-indexed, inclusive).

After all operations, print the final array.

Use the difference array technique to process all updates in O(N + Q) total time.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and Q.
Next Q lines: each contains three integers L, R, and V.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers on a single line.

starterCode.python:
n, q = map(int, input().split())
diff = [0] * (n + 2)
for _ in range(q):
    l, r, v = map(int, input().split())
    # Write your solution here using the difference array
result = []
cur = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    cur += diff[i]
    result.append(cur)
print(*result)
